senses.zh_definition: 埃莉；常见英语女性名字，也可作为 Eleanor、Ellen、Elizabeth 等名字的昵称。
senses.en_definition: Ellie, a feminine English given name, also used as a diminutive of Eleanor, Ellen, Elizabeth, and other El- names.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas perempuan dalam bahasa Inggeris yang juga digunakan sebagai nama panggilan bagi Eleanor, Ellen, Elizabeth dan beberapa nama lain.
senses.nuances: 这是专有名词，正常书写应首字母大写。中文“埃莉”为常见音译，具体人物可有其他译名；不能仅凭 Ellie 判断其正式姓名。以下为姓名搭配框架，未声称其语料频率。[Behind the Name：Ellie](https://www.behindthename.com/name/ellie)

etymology.historical_story: Ellie belongs to the English tradition of familiar names formed from longer personal names. It can be connected with Eleanor, Ellen, Elizabeth, and other names beginning with El. Because several names lead to the same familiar form, Ellie has no single underlying full name that can safely be assigned to every bearer. [Behind the Name: Ellie](https://www.behindthename.com/name/ellie)
